To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the introduction of prior information into the optimization of a neural network is crucial for learning tasks that involve composition of highly non-linear transformations, and this is in line with cultural learning hypotheses.

(1) introducing prior knowledge in the intermediate level of a two-tiered neural network can help to solve an otherwise unsolvable task; (2) the two-tiered architecture is more robust to overfitting than the standard single-tiered architecture; and (3) the two-tier architecture is more robust against noise and outliers in the data.

(a) introducing prior information at the intermediate level of a neural network architecture can be used to overcome optimization problems that are otherwise intractable, and (b) the introduction of prior knowledge in the intermediate level of the neural network architecture is consistent with hypotheses on human cultural learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the importance of prior knowledge in the form of intermediate level targets for learning complex tasks, and we provide evidence that this is indeed the case for a task on which all other algorithms failed.
the importance of prior information and supervision for learning, and how it relates to the difficulty of the optimization problem involved.
the effect of introducing intermediate level targets into the learning of a complex task.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the introduction of prior knowledge into an optimization problem is a very important factor that can help overcome the difficulty in finding an optimal solution.
the introduction of prior information into the learning task can significantly improve the performance of the algorithm.
introducing prior information at the intermediate level of the neural networks, which is equivalent to the use of a curriculum, can significantly improve learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the introduction of prior information into a neural network architecture, in the form of intermediate level pre-training, can help the network learn a task that it could not learn without the pre-training.
introducing prior information into an intermediate level of a neural network architecture can help the network to learn a difficult optimization problem.
the introduction of prior information in the intermediate level of a two-tiered neural network can help the learning process of the final task.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of prior knowledge is essential for optimization, and the absence of prior knowledge may lead to the failure of optimization.
prior knowledge is important for learning, even if it is only at the intermediate level.

prior knowledge is important in learning tasks, and that the intermediate concepts that we learn in the course of learning a task are often learned by observing others and then using them in a guided fashion to learn the final task.
